fact_text: The analyst says the KSE-100 needs to hold above about 115,000 points to keep its momentum, and he sees the market as sound while it stays at that level.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'KSE-100 EXPERT Reveals Extreme Market Shift Ahead!' (YouTube, 2025-01-15)

fact_text: The State Bank of Pakistan has cut its policy rate in a series of steps from 22 percent to 13 percent, according to the analyst.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'KSE-100 EXPERT Reveals Extreme Market Shift Ahead!' (YouTube, 2025-01-15)

fact_text: The State Bank of Pakistan's next monetary policy decision is due on the 27th of January 2025, and the analyst expects a further rate cut from 13 percent at that meeting.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'KSE-100 EXPERT Reveals Extreme Market Shift Ahead!' (YouTube, 2025-01-15)

fact_text: The analyst says lower policy rates support the equity market and favour interest-sensitive sectors, because cuts lower financing costs and help the market hold its momentum.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'KSE-100 EXPERT Reveals Extreme Market Shift Ahead!' (YouTube, 2025-01-15)

fact_text: The analyst cites Punjab's 'Apna Ghar Apni Chhat' housing scheme as a demand driver for cement makers, naming Maple Leaf Cement and Fauji Cement as likely beneficiaries.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'KSE-100 EXPERT Reveals Extreme Market Shift Ahead!' (YouTube, 2025-01-15)

fact_text: The analyst highlights Maple Leaf Cement as a cement maker with low enterprise value per tonne of capacity, a metric he uses to compare what capacity is worth across peers.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'KSE-100 EXPERT Reveals Extreme Market Shift Ahead!' (YouTube, 2025-01-15)

fact_text: Fauji Cement's enterprise value per tonne is cited at about 38 US dollars, which the analyst regards as a low level for a cement maker with several plants.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'KSE-100 EXPERT Reveals Extreme Market Shift Ahead!' (YouTube, 2025-01-15)

fact_text: The analyst describes Mughal Iron and Steel, the leading long-steel maker, as running well below its capacity, leaving room for growth when construction demand picks up.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'KSE-100 EXPERT Reveals Extreme Market Shift Ahead!' (YouTube, 2025-01-15)

fact_text: Long-steel makers that produce girders and structural products benefit from the same housing-driven demand that lifts cement, according to the analyst.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'KSE-100 EXPERT Reveals Extreme Market Shift Ahead!' (YouTube, 2025-01-15)

fact_text: Gas distributors Sui Northern and Sui Southern depend on gas price increases and tariff adjustments for their earnings, and the analyst links them to any shift in captive power plant gas demand.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'KSE-100 EXPERT Reveals Extreme Market Shift Ahead!' (YouTube, 2025-01-15)

fact_text: Airlink Communication, a Lahore-based mobile phone assembler, will take up TV manufacturing and assembly through its subsidiary Select Technologies.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'KSE-100 EXPERT Reveals Extreme Market Shift Ahead!' (YouTube, 2025-01-15)

fact_text: The analyst calls Airlink fairly valued but a growth company, one of the few in Pakistan that offers growth, with its mobile assembly business as the core of the case.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'KSE-100 EXPERT Reveals Extreme Market Shift Ahead!' (YouTube, 2025-01-15)

fact_text: Auto sales in December 2024 were not as strong month on month as in November, but year-on-year sales improved, according to the analyst.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'KSE-100 EXPERT Reveals Extreme Market Shift Ahead!' (YouTube, 2025-01-15)

fact_text: Millat Tractors sold about 4,800 tractors in December 2024, a bumper month that the analyst said puts its annual target within reach.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'KSE-100 EXPERT Reveals Extreme Market Shift Ahead!' (YouTube, 2025-01-15)

fact_text: Millat Tractors' annual target is 32,000 units, and the analyst expects the company to meet or exceed it, with production recovering in recent months.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'KSE-100 EXPERT Reveals Extreme Market Shift Ahead!' (YouTube, 2025-01-15)

fact_text: The analyst puts Millat Tractors' FY25 earnings per share at around 60 rupees and calls the stock fairly valued, with growth prospects in FY26 and FY27.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'KSE-100 EXPERT Reveals Extreme Market Shift Ahead!' (YouTube, 2025-01-15)

fact_text: The analyst puts Ghandhara Automobiles' FY25 earnings per share, for the year ending 30 June 2025, at about 40 to 45 rupees and calls the stock fairly valued.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'KSE-100 EXPERT Reveals Extreme Market Shift Ahead!' (YouTube, 2025-01-15)

fact_text: Ghandhara Automobiles' Chery-branded vehicles are selling well, and the analyst highlights a new Chinese model with a sunroof whose features compare favourably with rival brands.
